references.text: Here the pegs of the tabernacle and the courtyard are mentioned for the first time in the instructions for its construction, to which Exodus 35:18 refers back.
Describes the actual making of the pegs of the tabernacle and the courtyard, which are the same items mentioned in Exodus 35:18.
Mentions the pegs around the tabernacle and the courtyard as part of the finished work, parallel to the list of materials in Exodus 35:18.
Summarizes all parts of the tabernacle, including pegs and cords, corresponding with the elements mentioned in Exodus 35:18.
The responsibility of the Gershonites included the pegs of the courtyard and their cords, the same items as in Exodus 35:18.
The tasks of the Merarites included the pegs and cords of the courtyard, which are the same elements mentioned in Exodus 35:18.
